producer_report.summary: Redid both fixes from the base commit, with the missed fixture named. (1) The fake host in `crates/athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs` now returns a check run named 'fmt, clippy, tests'. The same edit went into the two unnamed fakes and two unnamed helper replies in `gh/tests.rs`, which was every one that a search of the code found. The retry test `land_pr_with_a_one_off_500_on_each_call_is_retried_and_lands` now ends Landed. (2) `classify_checks` in `gh/client.rs` judges only the check run named `CI_AGGREGATE_JOB`. It finds that run by name alone, takes the highest id and counts a missing id as 0, so a named run with no id still decides. A failed run is Red, a missing or unfinished one is Pending, and anything else is Green. Every other failed run and every failed legacy status becomes a note. It returns `CheckReport { checks, notes }` from the one check-runs read and the one status read. `PrHost::check_report` has a default that wraps `checks()`, and `GhClient` overrides it. `wait_for_checks` keeps the notes of the read behind its final verdict only, and `land_pr` adds them to `PrReport.warnings`. `EARLY_RUN_JOB` is now `CI_AGGREGATE_JOB`, so the name is defined once. (3) `closing_jobs` in `athena-gate/src/invariant.rs` skips a held job: a candidate with no verification, no outcome and no later outcome, which is what `hold_for_disk` commits. A job with an outcome and no verification still returns `Uncovered::NoVerification`. The doc comments, including the old 'no outcome stays in' sentence, and the `pr_commits` doc in `land.rs` match the new rule. Root causes are in the CHANGELOG entry and in the new decision D149 in `docs/decisions.md`. D149 also records the fixed-name assumption: a repository whose CI has no job of that name reads Pending and does not land. New tests: a table over `classify_checks`, `land_pr` through a `Reporting` runner fake (Landed with a warning, waiting and Green, required-red stays Red, missing required stays Pending), a one-read call-count test, and the held-job and finished-job tests for `classify_pre_merge`. The gate tests use the `Candidate2` record that `hold_for_disk` writes.

The tests assert only a combined-status failure of `failure` or `error` as a note; a `pending` combined status is now ignored entirely. The plan's open question (does a failed status still gate?) was answered as 'no, it is optional', following the request.
mistakes: My first held-job fixture used the `candidate()` helper, which has no base_fingerprint. The record is invalid as candidate/2 and was dropped when the job's files loaded, so the test failed. I fixed it by setting base_fingerprint and reran the test.
`cargo fmt --all` reformatted mod.rs and tests.rs after my edits; I reran fmt --check and it is clean.
learnings: A Candidate2 record must carry a base_fingerprint or `AnyRecord::parse` rejects it, and `JobFiles::load` then drops it silently. A test fixture built with the plain `candidate()` helper in landing_tests.rs therefore leaves the job with no candidate and makes it look unlike a held job.

In the base commit the fakes in gh/tests.rs (lines 86, 675, 680, 2192) and external_calls.rs:90 were all unnamed; the request's remark that gh/tests.rs 'now' names them referred to the discarded earlier candidate.
The only PrHost implementors that serve check runs through a real client are GhClient and the Runner fakes. The other PrHost fakes keep compiling because `check_report` has a default.
`gh/tests.rs` imports `EARLY_RUN_JOB` through the `#[cfg(test)] use early::EARLY_RUN_JOB` in gh/mod.rs. It stays valid because `EARLY_RUN_JOB` now aliases `CI_AGGREGATE_JOB`.
